name: myshelf
description: A self-hosted media journal and virtual bookshelf (books, movies, TV, music, video games, board games, YouTube).

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Your admin password. Make up a long random one (for example run `openssl rand -hex 24`) and keep it somewhere safe. You type it at **/admin/** to manage your shelf.

TMDB_TOKEN.description: Movies and TV. Free at [themoviedb.org](https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api): copy the **API Read Access Token**. Leave blank to add it later.

TWITCH_CLIENT_ID.description: Video games (IGDB). Register an app at [dev.twitch.tv/console](https://dev.twitch.tv/console). Leave blank to add it later.

TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The Client Secret from the same Twitch app. Leave blank to add it later.

BGG_TOKEN.description: Board games. Register a non-commercial app at [boardgamegeek.com/applications](https://boardgamegeek.com/applications) and create a token. Leave blank to add it later.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Music (optional; MusicBrainz is used without it). Create an app at [developer.spotify.com/dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard).

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The Client Secret from the same Spotify app (optional).

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Optional, and usually not needed: pasting video and channel links works without it, and search uses your Google Books key if YouTube Data API v3 is switched on in that Google Cloud project. Only set this to use a different key.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Optional. Sent to Open Library and MusicBrainz so they can reach you if something goes wrong, as they ask.
